nodes.title: Rename canonical published record bounds atomically
nodes.summary: Rename StationProductCatalog.start_date and end_date to published_record_start_date and published_record_end_date in the canonical schema; update the row dictionaries and STATION_PRODUCT_CATALOG_SCHEMA-backed construction in all thirteen provider generate_catalogue.py modules, including the USGS canonical output; update affected fixtures and assertions; and align ADR-0012 terminology and ADR-0014's Croissant Field example. In the same merge-green change, update each of the thirteen committed station_products.parquet artifacts by reading the existing artifact and performing only an in-place, value-preserving column rename, rather than rerunning provider generators: preserve every row, value, null, Date dtype, column position, and last_catalogue_check value byte-for-byte. This offline rewrite is required because br_ana and no_nve have no committed native.parquet and their small fixtures cannot reproduce their 52,145-row and 44,001-row packaged artifacts, while rerunning several generators would also replace caller-supplied last_catalogue_check dates. Preserve provider vocabulary outside the canonical fields: USGS SERIES_ONLY_FIELDS begin_date/end_date and its native fixtures remain unchanged, as do ThaiWater start_date/end_date request parameters and requested_start_date/requested_end_date observation locals; ADR-0015's removed station-level fields and historical design records are outside this rename. Acceptance evidence proves the renamed schema and all generator outputs use only the published_record_* canonical names, USGS published bounds retain their dates while null-bound providers remain null, and all thirteen packaged catalogues retain the measured row counts (180, 52,145, 16,114, 738, 4,155, 33,139, 4,092, 194, 44,001, 3,903, 1,650, 157,548, and 8,715 in provider order), exact eight-column order, Date types, and unchanged non-name data while loading successfully against STATION_PRODUCT_CATALOG_SCHEMA. Schema regression coverage must also prove no bare start_date or end_date remains as a canonical catalogue field. Schema and artifacts co-land because tests/test_package.py::test_all_packaged_catalogues_expose_exact_reduced_carriers asserts every committed station_products schema equals STATION_PRODUCT_CATALOG_SCHEMA.polars_schema.
